title: OpenAI sets promotional GPT-5.6 Sol pricing through at least November
friendlyTitle: GPT-5.6 Sol is cheaper for a limited time
summary: OpenAI’s current API pricing lists GPT-5.6 Sol at $4 per million short-context input tokens and $20 per million output tokens, with the promotional rate available through at least November 21. Batch and Flex processing halve those standard rates.
friendlySummary: OpenAI has lowered the current price of GPT-5.6 Sol until at least November 21. Slower Batch and Flex options cost even less.
whyItMatters: Temporary price reductions can materially change the economics of high-volume agents, but teams should model both promotional and post-promotion costs before committing a workflow to Sol.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This may make powerful AI agents cheaper to run. Businesses should still plan for the price to change later.
